messages:
deploy-bot: PRE-FLIGHT — prompt-eval gate FAILED for rollout `v4.2.4-canary`. Quality regression detected vs baseline. Holding promotion.

sam_ops: Ugh. Which eval set and which metric tripped it?

deploy-bot: Eval set `prod_prompt_smoke_v2` — delta: accuracy -4.7%, rouge-L -3.2%. Regression exceeds threshold (2%). See report: https://ci.internal/reports/1778941200

liza_pm: @carla_ml can you confirm this is a real regression and not noise from the new quantization profile? We should decide whether to pin previous model or patch quick.

carla_ml: digging in now. Quick summary — most failures are on few-shot instruction prompts where the model now oftens hallucinate entity values. Look at examples in the report. Not obviously infra/noise.

ben_eng: Any chance this is a tokenization change from the new tokenizer config? That would be a straightforward revert.

carla_ml: Tokenization diff is minimal. I ran a targeted eval of 200 samples with previous tokenizer + new model and still saw the drop. So likely model behavior change.

qa-bot: Attached artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/artifacts/1778941200/eval-diffs.tar.gz and failed-examples.csv

sam_ops: Given this is a canary -> prod promotion, my vote is to hold and pin to `v4.2.3` until we get a root cause. Rolling forward risks user-facing regressions.

liza_pm: Agreed. Action: put promotion on hold, pin `v4.2.3` for next 24h, open rollback play if any canary servers already on v4.2.4. Ben, can you prepare a rollback patch?

ben_eng: On it. Will create a rollback PR and a short rollback runbook. If we need immediate rollback I'll trigger the orchestration tag `rollback/v4.2.4` which will revert canaries in <10m.

carla_ml: I'll start bisect: narrow prompt families that regress, run small fine-tune / temp-quant test if needed. ETA 6h for an initial root-cause/proof.

sam_ops: Also add to release notes that promotion was blocked by prompt-eval gate and pinned. We should schedule a follow-up post-mortem if we don't resolve in 48h.

liza_pm: I'll update the release ticket and change window. For transparency: leaving the gating comment in the changelog and pinging customers on the delayed rollout.

deploy-bot: Promotion held. Current state: `v4.2.3` pinned for org default routing. Canary instances with `v4.2.4` are quarantined (no traffic). To unhold, require sign-off from @carla_ml + @liza_pm and green on `prod_prompt_smoke_v2` (thresholds met).

ben_eng: Rollback PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/4321 — includes runbook and test checklist.

carla_ml: Confirming I'll not sign-off until bisect narrows the failure mode or we have a hotfix. Posting intermediate results in ~3h.

liza_pm: Thanks all. Tagging this thread as `hold-prompt-eval` and will escalate in the 11:00 sync if unresolved. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sam_ops: Good catch, gate doing its job :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: End of thread update: hold enforced at 1778941200.
